company.shortDescription: Zenfuse is a cryptocurrency trading platform offering multi-exchange trading, portfolio analytics, and news.
company.description: Zenfuse is a comprehensive cryptocurrency trading platform. It offers the ability to trade on multiple cryptocurrency exchanges from a single secure account, accessible on both desktop and mobile platforms. The platform provides an intelligent ecosystem for cryptocurrency trading, portfolio analytics, and news. It also features a native token, ZEFU, with multiple use cases. Zenfuse's team comprises professionals with extensive experience in the crypto industry, each bringing unique digital product experience to the platform.
